note: Registry of numbered homonyms (generated by scripts/ko-build-lexicon.mts). The number is the etymology number of the source; set is the state (main, other, balanced) and by how it was settled (decision, only-current, default). A rebuild fails when a number now means another word: fingerprint {hanja, irr, voice} changed, glosses permuted, a number replaced, or a state changed (except default to decision); pass --accept-homonym-changes after deciding on a Repository alias.
